Commentary: The heavy roller has been at work for five minutes and the groundsmen are now putting the finishing touches on the pitch, restoring the markings ahead of the second innings.
Time for the action to get underway as players make their way out to the center. Similar to the hosts. The visitors start with spin too.
Mitchell Marsh and Fraser-McGurk are at the crease. Mitchell Marsh is on strike. Liam Dawson will open the attack
Liam Dawson to Mitchell Marsh, no run, hint of spin for Liam Dawson. Turns away from the right-hander. Marsh is behind the line with a solid defence
Liam Dawson to Mitchell Marsh, 1 run, fires it on middle. Mitchell Marsh punches it down to long-off
Liam Dawson to Fraser-McGurk, no run, flighted delivery on leg-stump. Jake Fraser-McGurk gets a big stride forward and blocks it back to Dawson
Liam Dawson to Fraser-McGurk, 1 run, Fraser-McGurk comes down the track and times the drive wide of long-off
Liam Dawson to Mitchell Marsh, 1 run, goes through with the arm on middle and leg. Tucked off the pads to deep mid-wicket
Liam Dawson to Fraser-McGurk, THATS OUT!! Bowled!!

Liam Dawson to Fraser-McGurk, out Bowled!! Wicket in the first over. Jake Fraser-McGurk loses his shape and his wicket. He will be disappointed with that shot. Comes down the track trying to hit it out of the park. He is nowhere near the ball, yet goes through with the shot. Liam Dawson dishes in an arm-ball and the ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad to smash into leg-stump. Fraser-McGurk doesn't bother to look back and he continues to march towards the pavillion. Ideal start for England. Fraser-McGurk b Liam Dawson 1(3)
Sam Harper, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Henry Crocombe, right-arm fast medium, comes into the attack

H Crocombe to Mitchell Marsh, SIX, no, no. You can't bowl there to Mitchell Marsh. He will hit you for a six everytime you bowl there. Short and into the hips. Mitchell Marsh gets inside the line and smokes the pull way into the stands. Huge six that
H Crocombe to Mitchell Marsh, no run, this one hits the good length and keeps climbing. Flies over the blade and through to the keeper as Marsh misses the cut
H Crocombe to Mitchell Marsh, no run, good length delivery outside off, pushed to the off-side
H Crocombe to Mitchell Marsh, 2 runs, back of a length delivery outside off, Mitchell Marsh dabs it down to third man. The ball runs down fine and the duo get back for a brace
H Crocombe to Mitchell Marsh, no run, good length delivery on middle stump. Defended back to Henry Crocombe
H Crocombe to Mitchell Marsh, 1 run, angled in from wide off the crease. Mitchell Marsh gets a thick inside edge on the push to the on-side
Liam Dawson to Mitchell Marsh, 1 run, quicker and slides into the right-hander. Pushed off the back foot to long-off
Liam Dawson to Sam Harper, no run, Dawson tosses it up on middle and leg. Sam Harper gets forward and defends it back to Liam Dawson
Liam Dawson to Sam Harper, no run, Sam Harper comes down the track and pushes it back to Dawson to a full delivery on middle and off
Liam Dawson to Sam Harper, 2 runs, to deep mid-wicket
Liam Dawson to Sam Harper, no run
Liam Dawson to Sam Harper, 1 run, to long-off

Jamie Overton to Sam Harper, wide
Jamie Overton to Sam Harper, FOUR, top-edge and races away for four.
Jamie Overton to Sam Harper, 2 runs, in the air and falls well short of the fielder at deep square leg. Harper goes for the pull. Picks the line fromm well outside off
Jamie Overton to Sam Harper, FOUR, to deep backward point
Jamie Overton to Sam Harper, SIX, wow! That is some shot when you are playing your first T20I game.
Jamie Overton to Sam Harper, FOUR, to third man
Jamie Overton to Sam Harper, no run
